activities.title: Quick check: #NAME? from an AI formula

blocks.prompt: AI suggests =SUMVALUES(E2:E9). The cell shows #NAME?. What happened?
options: The function doesn't exist; the AI invented it
The numbers are stored as text

activities.title: Module 3 Quiz: Spreadsheets
activities.intro: 10 items, 1 point each. Pick the one best answer for each item. Everything on it was covered in Topics 3.1 to 3.8.

blocks.prompt: 1. What is the address of the cell in column C, row 4?
2. Which way of typing a date is the safest?
4. Which formula counts how many item names are in A2:A9?
5. The 12% VAT rate is in B12. Which formula in G2 can you fill down safely?
6. Which formula shows cell E10 from the sheet named Jan?
7. You want to show how spending rose and fell from January to June. Which chart fits best?
options: Bar, sorted from biggest to smallest

blocks.prompt: 8. When is a pie chart the right choice?
options: To show shares of one whole that add up to 100%
To show a trend over 12 months

blocks.prompt: 9. AI gives you a formula for the inventory total. What do you check before you trust it?
options: Two rows by hand, the range, and the result against the total
Only that the cell shows no error
Ask the AI if it is sure

blocks.prompt: 10. Which of these is OK to paste into a public AI tool?
options: A list of clients with their TINs
Personnel records, if you delete them afterwards
Column headers and made-up sample rows
